decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program costs little to run, but dropping the 72-hour variant shows the firm is consolidating its delivery tiers, so A may be folded into the broader express line D; while its value is still unresolved, keeping it is the cheaper choice for now.
The European-certified exterior fire door extends the core modular fire-door system and serves steady compliance-driven demand, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The multi-model express line has its own page and is the strategic umbrella for fast delivery, so it is likely to absorb the narrower programs rather than be dropped.
The digital ordering and services platform has low marginal cost and high upside for trade partners and the firm's service-oriented direction, so the option stays open.
The fire and smoke protection door is close to the established certified offer, costs little to keep, and meets regulation-driven demand.
